title: Viewing the Graph for AI Services

blocks.text: After DSPM scans an Artificial Intelligence (AI) service, the Resource Inventory graph provides information about the primary resource, its associated resources, and its security posture. Depending on the AI service, the graph displays access paths to resources containing sensitive data, entities that can access the AI service, and public exposure information.
You can view graphs for the following AI services:
To view the graph for an AI service:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Resource Inventory.
Click any AI service name to view the AI service's details page.
The AI service's details page appears.
On the AI service's details page, select the Risk Explorer tab.
